item.title: 🇺🇸 US News: Six Flags closes nine major coasters after fatal Georgia ride incident
item.description:
Section: 🇺🇸 US News

A man was ejected from the Goliath coaster at Six Flags Over Georgia and died, prompting the company to temporarily close nine similar rides across six U.S. and Canadian parks while state officials and the manufacturer investigate restraint and safety questions. [1]

Sources: [1]

item.description:
Section: 🇺🇸 US News

Kimberly Guilfoyle resigned after the White House asked her to step down over allegations of improper and possibly illegal conduct, which she denies; the State Department inspector general is reportedly reviewing the matter. [2]

Sources: [2]

item.description:

Sources: [10]

item.title: 🤖 AI & Tech Breakthroughs: 400 scientists call for international advanced-AI oversight body
item.description:
Section: 🤖 AI & Tech Breakthroughs

Researchers including Geoffrey Hinton and Yoshua Bengio urged creation of a body to set containment standards and track significant security incidents for cyber-capable AI systems. The proposal argues voluntary commitments are insufficient for frontier models with external-network or cyber capabilities. [15]
